title.en: The sbilfs, the sprites of Carnia
title.de: Die Sbilfs, die Kobolde aus Karnien

about.en: The sbilfs are the little sprites of Carnian folklore (Friulian sbilf): small, quick, in a red cap, living in the woods and the houses of the mountains; they hide things, plait the horses' tails and spill the milk, and a household that leaves them a bowl of milk by the hearth finds them helping instead. text.it: In Carnia, nei boschi e nelle case, vivevano gli sbilfs. Erano folletti piccoli piccoli, con un berretto rosso. Il berretto era rosso come il fuoco.
text.sl: V Karniji, v gozdovih in hišah, so živeli sbilfi. Bili so čisto majhni škratje z rdečo čepico. Čepica je bila rdeča kot ogenj.
text.en: In Carnia, in the woods and the houses, lived the sbilfs. They were tiny little sprites with a red cap. The cap was red like the fire.

text.it: Gli sbilfs facevano tanti scherzi. Di notte nascondevano i cucchiai e le calze. Una nonna cercava e cercava: «Dove sono le mie calze?»

text.en: The sbilfs played lots of tricks. At night they hid the spoons and the socks. A grandma looked and looked: 'Where are my socks?'
text.de: Die Sbilfs trieben viel Schabernack. Nachts versteckten sie die Löffel und die Strümpfe. Eine Oma suchte und suchte: „Wo sind meine Strümpfe?“

text.sl: Zato je babica ob ognju pustila skodelico toplega mleka, za sbilfa. Sbilf je popil vse mleko.
text.en: So the grandma left a cup of warm milk by the fire, for the sbilf. The sbilf drank all the milk.
